artworks.title: Dialogue des morts
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side and engaged in conversation. The man on the left has a bushy beard and long hair, wearing a long robe. The man on the right is gesturing with one hand while holding a scroll labeled "TESISCHE" in the other. Both men wear robes and sandals. A third figure is partially visible behind them, wearing a tall hat and holding an object. The background is plain with text at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Électeurs, dans mes bras!...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a large book. The figure is defined by a pair of arms and legs, holding open an oversized book that dominates the scene. The book is titled "LE DIX NEUF JANVIER MEMOIRE-JUSTIFICATIF" in bold, capital letters. The scene shows a crowd of figures in the background moving towards or away from the book. The drawing style uses monochromatic shadings and line work. The composition creates a sense of urgency and drama regarding the content of the book. At the bottom, there is a caption in French: "Electeurs, dans mes bras!....." indicating the work's nature as satirical social or political commentary.

artworks.title: Embrassons nous
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures engaged in an intense interaction. One figure, partially visible from the waist up, is seated with wild, curly hair and is wearing a draped garment labeled "ALLEMAGNE." The other figure is shown in full profile, standing and leaning towards the seated individual. This person has short hair, a plumed military helmet, and a uniform with a belt. The standing figure has their arms stretched towards the seated person, seemingly holding them by the shoulders. The background is plain, focusing on the two figures.

artworks.title: Empedocle recevant... les honneurs divins...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple characters in an ancient setting, depicting a ceremonial event with mythical or allegorical figures. In the scene, a bearded person with elaborate headgear and another muscular figure, both in classical attire, interact with a robed figure who seems to be bestowing a wreath. Additional figures observe the spectacle. The scene is set against a backdrop of columns and smoke or clouds. The characters' expressions and body language are detailed, adding depth and narrative to the drawing.

artworks.title: Entre recors
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up. The man on the left stands with arms crossed, facing slightly towards the viewer but looking off to the side. He has deep-set eyes and a strong jawline, a large mustache, and a thick scarf around his neck. His tall top hat is slightly tilted. He wears a dark coat. The man on the right is turned away showing a profile view with a long nose and pointed chin with a mustache. He wears a light-colored shirt and hat, with arms behind his back, holding a stick. The background is plain with a focus on the two figures.

artworks.title: Étrennes pour 1867
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a comically exaggerated figure holding a large bayonet-rifle, set against a crowded background. The main subject is a cartoon-like character dressed in a voluminous skirt with the numbers "1867." The character appears to be struggling with the weight or size of the weapon. The background includes shadowy, indistinct figures and a stack of rifles to the right.

artworks.title: Expérience d'équilibre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a balancing scale with uneven weights. The drawing depicts an exaggerated scale where one side holds a large, rotund figure labeled "BUDGETS EUROPEENS" with numerical symbols that suggest a value of "1,000,000,000" and is much heavier than the opposite side, which holds a pyramid arrangement of numerous small spheres or balls. The scale is tilting significantly to the side of the rotund figure, illustrating an imbalance. The surrounding ground is scattered with additional loose balls or spheres. The composition uses line work and shading to emphasize the disparities.

artworks.title: Gare le déraillement!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a train derailing with a figure on top and a man on the tracks. The image features a steam locomotive on unstable tracks with a skeletal figure holding a trident riding on top. In the foreground, a man is adjusting a plank marked "Suffrage Universel." The tracks curve into the background, creating a sense of movement, urgency, and tension.

artworks.title: Invention charivarique
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure interacting with a cannon that has a clock face on it. The figure appears to be hunched over a staff or walking stick and is adorned in flowing robes. The exaggerated features and dramatic posture of the figure enhance the humor commonly found in satires. The setting is simple, with minimal background detail. The title "ACTUALITÉS" and subtitle "INVENTION CHARIVARIQUE" suggest it's a contemporary piece likely published in a periodical or as a standalone commentary. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: Jadis c'était différent
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures. A man is kneeling on a cobblestone street in the foreground, facing a large wheel. Behind him, a group of men is standing, all in formal attire with top hats, one of whom is holding a long stick. The backdrop includes a simplified outline of trees or foliage. The illustration is in a monochrome style.

artworks.title: L'Arène parlementaire
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures with exaggerated features gathered together in a caricatured representation. The figures appear to be in an environment labeled "L'arène parlementaire." Each figure has disproportionately large heads on small, muscular bodies. The figures display unique and expressive facial features and are interacting with each other in a way that suggests a discussion or debate. The background is minimal. The drawing uses stark lines and shading to emphasize the caricatures’ features and mannerisms.

artworks.title: La Femme a barbe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two characters engaging in a theatrical scene. The image depicts a dynamic interaction between two figures on a stage-like setting. On the left, a figure with exaggerated muscularity and facial hair is adorned in a voluminous dress and striking a powerful pose. On the right, a more somber figure draped in flowing fabric stands in contrast. Both figures are on a raised platform overlooked by an audience composed of sketched faces. The setting and style suggest a satirical or comedic representation, enhanced by the theatrical expressions of the characters. The line work is bold and the shading gives depth, emphasizing the dramatic tension between the two figures.

artworks.title: Le Festin de Baltazar-Véron
artworks.description: The image is a chaotic banquet scene depicted in dark pencil or charcoal. The characters have strong facial expressions and dramatic postures, reacting extravagantly around a table with dining objects. Light beams down on them from above. Background figures are seen reading papers labeled "PATRIE" and "CONSTITUTIONNEL." The scene conveys surprise and satire, with a sense of disarray and exaggerated caricature elements.

artworks.title: Le Mot d'ordre: Réaction... Pardon... Liberté
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, each depicted from head to toe. The central figure is an old man with a prominent face, long hair, and a beard. He is holding a scythe and wearing draped garments. To the left is a ghostly figure in a shroud, with facial features concealed. To the right is a woman in a gown. The background is plain, and the numbers 1869 and 1870 are displayed above the figures.

artworks.title: Le Rêve de l'inventeur du fusil a aiguilles...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing in a landscape. The figure has exaggerated features and seems confident. The background shows a barren land with various bodies scattered around. The image is in monochrome with sharp lines. The title hints at the invention of a weapon, possibly the needle gun, and its consequences, symbolized by the Day of the Dead association.

artworks.title: Le Secret confié au dieu faune
artworks.description: The image displays a series of flowing, curved lines forming an ornate frame around the central scene. Soft, swirling shapes make up the interior space. A winged, cherub-like figure interacts with a bust on a pedestal, appearing to whisper into its ear. The scene features elements of classical sculpture and pastoral landscapes, with the bust potentially representing a historical figure. Light and shadow create tree-like shapes in the background. The juxtaposition of the cherub and the sculpture blends lifelike and static qualities within the artwork.

artworks.title: Le Temps éprouvant lui aussi le besoin de s'équiper a la mode
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure flying in clouds with a long staff, accompanied by a scroll. The image shows a bearded, winged figure in motion among swirling clouds, carrying a staff. The figure's attire and posture suggest determination. The style of the drawing, with bold lines and defined contrasts, adds a dramatic effect to the composition. The clouds are depicted with curving lines, giving the impression of floating or drifting. The drawing carries a sense of historical or mythical narrative, as suggested by the text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le vrai feu d'artifice est d'être libéral
artworks.description: The image features sweeping curved lines and dots creating a radial pattern spreading out from a central point. A human figure with an outstretched arm is encircled by these shapes. Above the figure are words like "PROGRÈS SOCIAL," "LIBERTÉ," and "PROGRÈS POLITIQUE" arcing across the scene. The composition suggests the orchestration or initiation of celebration or change.

artworks.title: Les Cadeaux de Noël de 1868
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure observing a pile of cannonballs and a large cannon. The figure wears a crown and a robe labeled "Europe." The scene is indoors with an arched entryway in the background. The cannon and cannonballs are arranged as a gift. The drawing is detailed with shading that adds depth to the robe and objects. The use of contrast highlights spikes behind the cannon. The title at the bottom is "Les cadeaux de Noël de 1868."

artworks.title: Les Politiques de café
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated at a table. The person on the left is reclined back, holding a cigar with smoke rising, and has distinct facial features and short curly hair. The person on the right is standing upright, with sideburns, curly hair, and holding a small cup on a saucer. The surroundings are lightly sketched, indicating a cafe or room, with faint depictions of other figures and furniture in the background.

artworks.title: Les Trains de plaisir
artworks.description: This drawing shows a group of people crowding to enter a train. It depicts a busy scene at a train station with a packed platform, open train doors, and individuals struggling to board. The artwork features a comical exaggeration of the rush to gain entrance, with people in top hats and Victorian attire, suggesting a 19th-century setting. Dynamic lines and expressive faces capture the chaotic and humorous moment.

artworks.title: Ne tirez pas!!!
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration depicting a scene of hunting with a dog and two human figures in a wooded area. In the foreground, a dog is shown pointing or tracking something in the underbrush. In the middle ground, a person is holding a firearm, while another figure in the background is gesticulating. The forest setting is filled with trees and foliage, creating a rich backdrop for this dynamic scene of action in a hunting context.

artworks.title: Non... vous n'êtes pas de cette pièce-la!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure with a scythe addressing a crowd. The drawing portrays a skeletal, ghostly figure resembling the Grim Reaper who holds a scythe and stands on a stage. To his left, a crowd of ghastly, disembodied heads seem to look up towards him. The backdrop behind the figure includes bold text. Shadows and cross-hatching are used to create depth and texture in the scene.

artworks.title: Oedipe
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals captured from the waist up. The person on the left is seated, leaning backwards in a chair with their body slightly turned away. They have wide eyes and a pointed nose, with tightly curled hair partially covered by a fabric or veil. They are dressed in loose, flowing garments. The individual on the right is leaning forward, with a dynamic posture. This person has a bearded face with pronounced features, including wild, spiky hair. They are wearing a short-sleeved shirt layered with a vest, and their hand is visible at their side. The background is simply shaded.
